prompts: Create a production game directional sprite atlas with TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Use attached atlas ONLY as character design reference: reproduce its ochre hood teal cape survivor and amber glass seed insect. Do not include its plants. Square 2048x2048, EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows equal square cells, 16 isolated full-body sprites, centered with consistent scale and bottom anchor at 88% within each cell, generous clear margins. No labels, grid, ground, shadows, scenery or background glow. Camera fixed elevated oblique 2.5D view; character bodies stay upright, rotate around vertical axis, never rotate flat artwork. First TWO ROWS: SAME human survivor in eight views. Row1 left to right SOUTH facing viewer (face/visor visible), SOUTHWEST facing lower-left, WEST facing left profile, NORTHWEST back-left. Row2 left to right NORTH full back facing away (backpack visible), NORTHEAST back-right, EAST right profile, SOUTHEAST front-right. Last TWO ROWS: SAME active seed sentinel in identical order. Row3 SOUTH eyes/beak toward viewer, SOUTHWEST lower-left beak, WEST left profile beak, NORTHWEST beak away-left. Row4 NORTH back with eyes hidden, NORTHEAST away-right, EAST right profile, SOUTHEAST toward lower-right. Sentinel has clearly directional dark chitin head/beak, amber seed nucleus and two translucent fins trailing behind, not radial symmetry. All views consistent anatomy and size. Survivor feet at same baseline in relaxed stride pose, no weapon. Painterly detailed ivory ceramic, ochre hood, dark teal kelp cape, amber glass. Preserve identity of reference. Truly transparent empty space.

Correct this sprite atlas for actual game use. Keep same character design. EXACT 4x4 equal square grid on fully transparent square canvas. Each sprite MUST have 15% empty margin on every side of its cell, max height 70% cell, feet bottom centered at85%cell. No sprite may touch a cell border. Top two rows same survivor, bottom two rows same sentinel. Make view directions unambiguous: row1 FRONT (toward viewer), front LEFT (toward lower left), LEFT profile (nose left), back LEFT (away upperleft). Row2 BACK (away viewer with NO face visible), back RIGHT (away upperright), RIGHT profile, front RIGHT (toward lower right). Repeat EXACTLY these views for the sentinel row3 and4, head/beak points direction of travel with wings behind. BACK sentinel view shows tail/wing backs with head pointing AWAY UPWARD and NO visible eyes. Keep full body upright with fixed elevated camera; not planar rotated pictures. All 16 sprites consistent scale, evenly spaced cell centers. TRUE clean alpha transparency, no cast shadows or colored fringes, no labels or ground. This is a sprite sheet used with exact equal grid sampling. Reduce each character size to leave generous empty space!
